text:
sophia (design): Quick UX review — proposed compact time-window affordance for the latency view. Idea: a single-line control above the heatmap with presets (1m/5m/15m/1h), a lightweight custom range opener, and a tiny density slider for sampling. Sketch: https://figma.com/file/x (see header area). jamal (frontend): I like the compact header. Question: do we keep sampling as a primary control or tuck it under “advanced”? It adds visual noise but people use it. tyler (eng): From infra POV, sampling adjustments map to different backend routing. If it’s too discoverable people will toggle it a lot and we’ll see config churn. Maybe default collapsed? alex (pm): Use cases: quick toggles are common when investigating spikes. If it’s hidden, we should provide a keyboard shortcut + clear tooltip. aria (a11y): Accessibility nits — small things: (1) ensure presets are keyboard focusable and announced (e.g., `aria-live` updates when range changes), (2) density slider needs aria value text: "Sampling: 10%". Also contrast on the mini legend chips is low on the dark theme. sophia (design): Agree on discoverability tradeoff. Proposal: primary controls = presets + custom-range button. Sampling control: collapsed pill with a chevron that expands to micro-slider. That keeps the bar compact but discoverable. jamal (frontend): Implementation idea (pseudo): ```
[1m] [5m] [15m] [1h]
Sampling: 10%
``` When pill expanded we show a slider with `input[type=range]` and live value text. tyler (eng): That’ll work. Two engineering asks: (A) expose the sampling setting in the route query so we can cache/unify metrics; (B) telemetry event for preset usage vs custom so PMs can decide defaults. alex (pm): Telemetry yes. Also add a small help tooltip: "Sampling reduces cost / increases throughput; lowers resolution." Short copy only. We should A/B test showing the brief explanation inline vs in a docs link. aria (a11y): Copy tweak suggestion for tooltip: replace "reduces cost / increases throughput" with "reduces storage and processing; may hide short spikes." More concrete. And ensure tooltip uses role="tooltip" and is dismissible via Esc. metrics-bot: Auto-note: event: `timebar_preset_click` fired by sophia at 1958002540 jamal (frontend): Minor UI nit — when density slider is at very low values the heatmap buckets look like single-pixel columns which can be confusing. Suggest adding a low-density hint state: an overlay text "low sampling: higher noise" + subtle pattern on cells for colorblind accessibility. sophia (design): Love the pattern idea. Also: keep p95 pinned in the header — even when compact the p95 number should stay visible and tappable to open distribution panel. People look at p95 first. tyler (eng): Implementation note: pinning the p95 as a separate element makes rerender cheaper. We can memoize the p95 calculation and only update on range change. alex (pm): Decision call: we will ship v1 with presets + collapsed sampling pill + p95 pinned. Followups: A11y checklist from aria, telemetry hooks from tyler, frontend prototype from jamal. aria (a11y): I’ll write the checklist. Quick items: focus order, aria-live for chart update, keyboard access for custom range dialog, tooltip semantics, contrast checks for legend chips. jamal (frontend): I’ll prototype the collapsed pill and low-density overlay by EOD Friday. sophia (design): Thanks team. Small copy for the sampling pill I want to test: "Sampling — quick mode" vs "Sampling — retain detail". Will bring to UX sync. :sparkles:
